Exactly EIGHT complete figures, FOUR columns by TWO rows.

Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Aaron is the ONE BLUE cat-like Sproto in reference image 1. Preserve TWO tall pointed blue ears with YELLOW inner ears, YELLOW rear head spikes, sleepy half-lidded YELLOW eyes with small BLACK pupils, black rounded heart-like nose, and the VERY LARGE LONG RED mouth. The mouth is the defining correction: match the reference enormous broad thick RED horizontal muzzle/lips, spanning about 85 percent of the head width and protruding clearly FAR beyond the right cheek in side view. The mouth is broad vertically too, about one quarter of head height, with a long curved black closed smile crease inside it. It begins well left of the nose and continues past the nose to the right; the upper/lower lips form one wide flattened capsule-like red muzzle. Do NOT turn this into a tiny smile, narrow red line, small snout, short beak, open toothed mouth or tongue. Keep the BLACK nose entirely above the mouth. Preserve original head width rather than enlarging the entire head.
Keep the established costume: thick bright YELLOW collar and YELLOW gloves/hands, BLACK fitted outfit with broad WHITE chest panel/shirt, BLACK long trousers and BLACK/YELLOW shoes. No cape, new logos or color changes. Exactly one complete blue character, two arms and two low-rooted legs. Reference image 2 is the APPROVED revised combat sheet; match its complete-body proportions, revised costume/face, exact colors and pixel style.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. Every pose keeps the SAME very large protruding thick RED mouth and black nose above it. No teeth, tongue or tiny mouth. Mouth occupies most of face width, visibly larger than in image 2, without covering eyes or nose. Preserve the costume and existing two-arm/two-leg anatomy. Keep all mouth tips, ears, fingers and feet fully inside their cells. No detached effects, labels or extra subjects.
